QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Seal of Approval
QuestInfo.1: Dabo wants concrete evidence to prove the seals innocent. Defeat #rPossibly-Evil Walruses#k in #bUnderwater Ice Cave 3#k and bring back #b10 Garbled Commands#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Dabo a stack of #bGarbled Commands#k to prove the seals innocent.

0.0: I'm not certain we've rooted out our problem. Deeper in that cave, you'll find #rPossibly-Evil Walruses#k. Bring back a little #bevidence#k from them, if ya please.
